text: Chats in one app. Files in another. Deadlines in your head.
What if your whole project lived in one place?
Welcome to Collabify. One place where classes and teams plan, build, and finish together.
Make it yours. Pick every color, from your banners to your status highlights. Light, or dark.
Start with a work space. Every project your team runs lives here, with its own look, overview, and reports.
Give everyone a role: project manager, coordinator, member, QA, or stakeholder. Then build teams, with leads, positions, and the skills each person brings.
Turn a file or a meeting into work. Upload a plan, or pick a saved discussion, and Collabify drafts the tasks. You keep only what you want.
Too much for one person? Break down and balance splits a big task, and gives each piece to someone with the skills, and the hours, to do it.
Not sure how to pace it? Suggest sprints lays out the cycles for you, from your dates and your work.
Set the stages, the task rules, priorities, subtasks, and dependencies. Then automate it: when this happens, do that.
And when it's time to talk, meet right inside Collabify. No links to another app.
In the classroom, teachers set up each class, its look, and its syllabus.
Projects start from a brief. Tasks come from a file, and anything off the brief is flagged.
Groups plan and hand in. Teachers grade with a rubric, right on the work.
And analytics show who needs help, with reports ready to export.
Collabify. Plan, build, and finish, together.
